## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Grouped/uncluttered/keyboard-accessible nav replacing the flat 13-link bar; fix hardcoded
   `/dossier/oklahoma-city/` → dossier index; reconcile map↔reference-map + network↔reference-graph.
2. National landing page: honest headline counts (named denominators, no total), jurisdiction reach,
   entry points, epistemic framing.
3. Per-jurisdiction dossier index over all publishable jurisdictions (P27.4 dossier index).
4. Real metadata: `astro.config.mjs` `site = https://surveillancegraph.org`; belief-pinned
   permalink + as_of/ruleset from the export **manifest**, not the frozen `fixtures.ts` constant.
5. Cohesive modern design system site-wide (zero-JS; React optional/static-only — SKIPPED, `.astro`+CSS).
6. Records: run ledger, PR body; cite ADR-093 (already Accepted — no new ADR); spec fold-back.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] nav grouped + uncluttered + keyboard-accessible; no hardcoded OKC dossier link; map/network dup resolved
- [ ] landing renders national overview with named denominators + no total; per-jurisdiction index lists all publishable jurisdictions
- [ ] canonical `site` + belief-pinned permalink + as_of/ruleset from the export manifest (no sig.example, no frozen 2026-08-20)
- [ ] design system applied site-wide; `npm --prefix web run check` green in BOTH modes (incl. axe WCAG 2.2 AA)
- [ ] zero-JS budget holds on every public page; `make check` + build-memory green

## Plan

- **Config/metadata:** `astro.config.mjs` site → surveillancegraph.org; `data.ts` `getSiteMetadata()`
  reads `<exportDir>/manifest.json` `reproducibility_inputs` in export mode, fixtures constant otherwise;
  `build-fixture-export.ts` also emits `manifest.json`; `BaseLayout` default as_of/ruleset + canonical
  fallback from the data layer.
- **Nav/IA:** grouped nav in BaseLayout (primary/secondary/reference) via keyboard-accessible markup;
  Dossiers → `/dossier/` index.
- **Landing:** rebuild `index.astro` from `getCoverage()`/`getDossierIndex()`/`getFreshness()`.
- **Dossier index:** new `dossier/index.astro` over `getDossierIndex()`.
- **Duplication:** fold reference-map + reference-graph demos into `visual-language.astro`; delete the two
  route files; update tests + `pages.ts` + two fixture link targets.
- **Design system:** extend `epistemic.css` (spacing/type tokens, header/nav, landing cards).
- **Spec fold-back:** mint SIG-UI-048 (§39.2) + SIG-UI-049 (§39.9) in spec_src; BUILD.sh; coverage rows;
  bump checkers 674→676; advance D-P27-SPEC-1.
